narrative.overview: The shared ink and green palette connects public pages, account forms and Studio. Public links, working controls and Urdu captions remain legible across screen sizes.
keyCharacteristics: An off-white canvas, green actions and quiet white working panels.
Nastaliq text in the caption demo and on sample media.
Shared public navigation and focused Studio controls.

rules.name: Green Selection
rules.body: Use green wash for current cues and navigation. Use the primary green fill for the selected caption format.

rules.name: The Urdu Line Height Rule
rules.body: Allow about two ems of vertical space per Urdu caption line. Mark Urdu sample captions with their language and reading direction, and use directional isolation or automatic direction for user content.

rules.name: Panel Depth
rules.body: Keep routine panels flat and bordered. Reserve text shadow for captions placed on footage.

dos: Do preserve a clear selected state for formats, navigation, and the current cue.
Do keep Urdu script selectable and give it its own line height and direction.
Do keep captions legible over footage with fitted strips or the local preview text shadow.
donts: Don't bake captions into an illustrative still used for the interactive demo.
Don't add ambient shadow to routine Studio panels.
Don't apply the tight display leading to Urdu captions.
